title: Flat 10 steps then positive 15 degree tilt for 20 steps
action_protocol: Replay each held-out flat-tilt action sequence unchanged under every matched schedule
switch_protocol: Before executing action at the declared step, rotate the complete physical state into the new board frame without advancing time or changing public state/history
terminal_protocol: Continue through goal success; stop on collision, fall/boundary, source exhaustion, or 30 transitions
transition_family: Three-state symmetric time-homogeneous Markov law; one shared off-diagonal probability
transition_selection: Development-selected off-diagonal probability 0.03, frozen before the final replay
test_policy: Final E2 on fixed held-out source cases; identical actions and observations across models
confidence_intervals: 20000-draw percentile bootstrap over the 12 source-episode blocks; retain matched no-switch trials; disclose available blocks at each step
transition_hazard_definition: h = 2 * off_diagonal_probability; diagonal = 1-h, each alternative = h/2
context_update: predictive_prior = T @ posterior; next_posterior proportional to untempered learned likelihood * predictive_prior
